text:
maria_pm: quick sync — pricing/packaging change is moving to staging today. need clear ownership for quota + contract clause checks before we promote to prod :eyes:

sam_eng: on it. i'll pick up the metering adapter changes and the quota guardrail mapping. PR queued: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/5823

maria_pm: thanks. primary blocker is contract clause A.3 — legal flagged a behavioral quota clause that affects burst billing. pri_qa can you confirm test coverage?

pri_qa: I'll run the contract-edge test matrix this morning. quick question: does the new packaging change alter plan_id semantics for legacy customers?

sam_eng: yes — we add plan_variant field for new plans, but we must continue to accept legacy plan_id strings. adding translation layer in meter adapter.

leo_infra: FYI the quota-enforcer service needs a minor schema bump. will push migration script. ETA ~2h. watch for deploybot rolling window.

billing_bot: automated-check — contract-clauses: FAIL (clause A.3 regression: burst rounding), metering-compat: PASS, quota-schema: WARNING (schema-major bump detected). See /ops/reports/2034567890

maria_pm: @billing_bot thanks — sam, can you prioritize the rounding fix? legal wants a repro before signoff.

sam_eng: on it. quick repro steps i'm trying:
```
# reproduce billing rounding
curl -X POST /v1/usage -d '{"plan_id":"legacy-std","tokens":1234}'
```
I'll report back with simple failing test case.

pri_qa: i'll add an e2e that asserts invoice math for burst usage. if sam posts failing case I'll wire it into the CI job.

leo_infra: migration script PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/9012 — i'll gate it behind canary and a manual approval step.

maria_pm: plan: sam fixes rounding + publish repro by EOD, pri adds e2e, leo schedules migration canary, legal to re-review once billing_bot passes. mark blockers here so we can promote. :thumbsup:

sam_eng: marking tasks in the project board now. ping me for code review.

pri_qa: noted. i'll be on-call for validation after canary.

billing_bot: state-update — billing-tests: running (50% complete). will post results.

maria_pm: perfect. thanks team — i will ping contracts/legal for the re-review once the failing case is posted.
